concerns: Double EnableCaching configuration annotation is redundant.
Integration test calls getCampaign twice but does not assert that the mock repository was only invoked once, which weakens the cache validation.
Programmatic eviction of conversation caches within a database transaction block could lead to performance bottlenecks under heavy write loads.
Use of raw types in PageImplDeserializer cast may trigger compiler warnings or type safety issues.
SimpleValueWrapper wrapping in FailSafeCache.get may strip custom implementation metadata from the underlying ValueWrapper delegate.
Using a SpyBean on cacheManager in tests might slow down test suite execution due to context dirtiness.
